newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: GPG 96 net surges, no dividend planned.
newsitem.headline: GPG 96 net surges, no dividend planned.

text.p: Slovenian construction company Gradbeno Podjetje Grosuplje (GPG) said on Monday 1996 net profit surged to 80.5 million tolars ($491,753) from 11.3 million tolars a year ago.
"Our profit was up mainly due to an increase in revenue as the domestic market and its demands increased," Irena Daris, GPG's spokeswoman told Reuters.
Revenue jumped to 8.27 billion tolars from 5.87 billion in 1995.
GPG would not pay a dividend for 1996, she added. GPG has not paid out a dividend for the previous two years. -- Novica Mihajlovic, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
